images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: district environment concept for Brackett, a top-down 3D city action game. Make one rich landscape concept image, no collage, labels, titles or watermark. Use the attached whole-island concept ONLY as style reference: smooth stylized game-ready-looking architecture, dark blue/petrol materials, broad clean forms, saturated but selective electric accents, readable cool blue-hour fill and warm windows. This is a district close overview, not a separate island or redesign of the city. Flat terrain. Show varied footprints and setbacks, a few chunky cars and tiny people for scale, enough open ground for action. High aerial three-quarter presentation with roofs prominent; this is a mood illustration, not a gameplay screenshot. Keep foliage sparse, surfaces smooth, avoid gritty texture, photorealism, dense greebles, equal repeated blocks, continuous neon roof outlines, rain, giant text, weapons or UI. Bright sociable commercial/entertainment district, cheeky electric character. Short unequal shopping blocks with many distinct small frontage widths and roof depths, some mixed-height infill, connected pedestrian passages visible through blocks and rear service courts. Quiet indigo/slate roofs with muted plum walls, magenta and cyan concentrated on broad storefront signs and short canopies. Landmark rounded entertainment hall with one broad luminous magenta roof ring beside a generous OPEN PLAZA, cyan entry accent. Two-lane shopping streets, generous foot space, sparse seating and poster drums, a few rear parked cars. Strongest neon of the city but roads and roof centres remain quiet and readable. No real brands or large legible text, no dense crowd hiding ground.
